FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
A license grants the privilege of driving on public roads, while an ID card only proves identity and never permits driving [A01].
Why it matters: group license-basics; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F01, sec01-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Licensing requires two different tests: a knowledge test plus a behind-the-wheel drive test, both drawn from the handbook [A01].
Why it matters: group testing-path; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
Class C is the noncommercial license most drivers need, but commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and other types each need a different class [A01].
Why it matters: group license-classes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F04, sec01-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
REAL ID compliance unlocks three separate doors: boarding domestic flights, entering military bases, and entering most federal facilities [A01].
Why it matters: group card-designations; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F06, sec01-F07, sec01-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A01
Card designations split three ways: REAL ID governs federally controlled access, Veteran designation carries its own requirements and benefits, and organ donor status is recorded separately [A01].
Why it matters: group card-designations; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F06, sec01-F10, sec01-F11 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A01
ID cards are open to any age yet demand three proofs: an identity document, residency documents, and a social security number [A01].
Why it matters: group identity-documents; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F12, sec01-F13 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A01
Immigration status never blocks a license, but ID cards still require residency documents among their proofs [A01].
Why it matters: group identity-documents; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F09, sec01-F13 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A01
Each topic has its own portal: Class C coverage lives under the license pages, REAL ID under its own application pages, veterans under theirs, and ID cards under theirs [A01].
Why it matters: group portals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F14, sec01-F15, sec01-F11, sec01-F16 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]
